I have been looking for homemade highs, they are simple to find but something aroused my intrests. Now dont go saying I'm stupid I know I am but hey cheap highs are fun right?
At around 11:00 parents are alseep and I decided to try out huffing gas (I read about it serval times) so I'm outside with the gas can and I take one really short breath with my mouth aginst the cap nothing well I think to my self 'go big or go home'. So I take 30-40 deep breaths in and black. I don't know how long I was out when I came to my vision was vibrating and drawing in and out. I go back in the house still feeling buzzed and its 12:03 am I was out for at least 15 min and I smell heavily of gasoline.
12:15 'hangover' starts its like the nausea from drinking combined with a 101 fever, I was laying in bed trying to forget the pain/nausea did not work.
Its now 3:00 in the morning I still have a slight' hangover' but not as bad as it was.
All and all not worth it I hated the hangover more than I liked the high would not recommend to anyone in there right mind smoke weed or catnip.
